notes: one dropdown for the whole app: model, chat mode, settings fields, per-tool policies and the plugin setup wizard all use the same picker as the folder menu - rows carry a sub-line (a model's context window and price, what a mode or connection route actually does), long lists get a filter field, and the keyboard drives all of it (arrows, type-ahead, Enter, Escape); one outside click or Escape closes whatever menu is open; fixes: the settings nav item 'Chat modes & permissions' wrapped onto a second line (now 'Modes & permissions', and no nav label can wrap again), and the dropdown arrow no longer stays warm grey in the dark theme
